rules.title: How to play
rules.r1: Put your finger (or the mouse) on the ball and swipe towards the spot you want to hit: where your swipe ends is your target.
rules.r2: A fast swipe is a harder shot (the keeper can't get there, but the ball flies flatter); draw a curved path and the ball curls along it, around the wall.
rules.r3: Each series has 5 shots; the ball position, the wall and the keeper's movement change every shot.
